Har raat ke baad
ek savera hota hai.

Humari kahaani mein khushi ke pal bhi hain aur mushkil din bhi. Main yeh nahi kehta ki sab kuch aasaan hai—bas itna chahta hoon ki hum jo mehsoos kar rahe hain, use imaandari se samjhein. Tumhari feelings bhi utni hi important hain jitna mera pyaar.

Humari yaadein dekho ♡

ek doosre ko samajhna hai.

Relationship mein disagreement ho sakta hai. Lekin hurt ko ignore karna, baar-baar wahi galti dohrana, ya kisi par jaldi theek hone ka pressure daalna sahi nahi. Achha rishta tab banta hai jab dono ki baat suni jaaye aur dono ki izzat bani rahe.

Pyaar, sabr aur saath

Humari kahaani ko sirf mushkil waqt se mat naapna ♡

Humare beech jo problems hain, woh important hain aur unhe theek karna zaroori hai. Lekin un problems ke saath-saath humari hasi, care, memories, letters, birthday cake, milne ke pal aur ek-doosre ke liye mehsoos kiya gaya pyaar bhi toh humari kahaani ka hissa hain. Aaj ka dard poori kahaani nahi hai—aur achhi yaadein bhi aaj ke dard ko mita nahi deti. Dono ko saath dekhna zaroori hai.

🌿 Misaal 1: Ram aur Sita — mushkil raaste par saath

Ramayan ki kahaani mein, Ram ko chaudah saal ke vanvaas par jaana pada aur Sita ne unke saath van mein jaane ka faisla kiya. Rajmahal ki suvidhaon ke bajaye unhone mushkil raasta chuna. Baad mein jab Sita ka haran hua, Ram ne unhe dhoondhne ke liye lamba sangharsh kiya aur Ravan ke viruddh yuddh hua. Is kahaani ko log samarpan, himmat aur apne priya ke liye koshish ki misaal ke roop mein yaad karte hain.

Jab main is misaal ko humare rishte se jodkar sochta hoon, toh mere dil mein yeh sawaal aata hai: agar kisi rishte mein pyaar, izzat aur saath nibhane ki sachchi ichchha ho, toh kya har mushkil aate hi humein sirf us mushkil ko dekhkar poori kahaani ka faisla kar lena chahiye? Kya hum ek baar ruk kar yeh bhi dekh sakte hain ki humare beech kya-kya khoobsurat raha hai aur kya badla ja sakta hai?

Main yeh misaal tumhe guilt dene ya tumse dard sehne ko kehne ke liye nahi de raha. Main bas chahta hoon ki hum apne pyaar ko halka na samjhein—aur uski keemat sirf bade vaadon se nahi, balki ek-doosre ki izzat, galti maan-ne, maafi ke baad badlaav aur mushkil baat ko milkar suljhane ki koshish se dikhayein. Hamare beech ki problem badi lag sakti hai, lekin zaroori nahi ki woh humari poori kahaani se badi ho. Agar hum dono chahein, toh use samajhne aur sudhaarne ki koshish kar sakte hain.

🌦️ Misaal 2: Jab do logon ne sirf ladai nahi, apna poora safar dekha

Socho do log hain jinhone ek saath bahut si chhoti-badi khushiyan jee hain—pehli mulaqat ki yaad, ek doosre ke liye likhe letters, birthdays, hasi-mazaak, ek doosre ko yaad karna aur future ke sapne. Phir waqt ke saath kuch galatfahmiyan hoti hain. Kuch baatein baar-baar hurt karti hain aur dheere-dheere jab bhi woh baat hoti hai, toh purani takleef bhi saamne aa jaati hai. Aise mein kabhi-kabhi lagne lagta hai jaise rishte mein ab sirf problems hi reh gayi hain.

Phir dono ek doosre se do sawaal poochte hain: “Humare beech kya achha raha hai?” aur “Humare beech kya badalna zaroori hai?” Pehla sawaal unhe yaad dilata hai ki unka rishta sirf ladai ka naam nahi. Doosra sawaal unhe problems se bhaagne nahi deta. Woh achhi yaadon ko sambhalte hain, hurt ko dhyaan se sunte hain, boundaries ka respect karte hain aur promises ke bajaye chhote actions par dhyaan dete hain.

Har cheez ek din mein theek nahi hoti. Lekin dheere-dheere unhe yeh samajh aata hai ki achhe pal bhi sach the aur problems bhi sach hain. Aaj ki problem ka matlab yeh nahi ki pehle ki har khushi jhoothi thi. Aur pehle ki khushiyon ka matlab yeh bhi nahi ki aaj ke dard ko ignore kar diya jaaye. Puri kahaani dekhne ka matlab hai—achhai ko yaad rakhna aur problem ko imaandari se sudhaarna.

Humare liye meri baat: Ashvini, main chahta hoon ki tumhe humari kahaani mein sirf woh din na dikhein jab hum hurt hue. Humare achhe pal bhi dekho—woh photos, woh letters, woh cake, woh mulaqat, woh hasi aur woh care jo humne ek doosre ko di. Main yeh nahi keh raha ki bas unhe yaad karke sab bhool jao. Main chahta hoon ki un achhe palon ko bhi jagah mile, aur jo galtiyan hui hain unhe main apne actions se sudhaarne ki koshish karoon.

Baaton se aage

Main apni taraf se kya karunga

Yeh bade-bade vaade nahi. Yeh woh cheezein hain jinhe actions mein dikhana hai.

1

Tumhari baat poori sunna

Beech mein safai dene se pehle samajhna ki tumhe kis baat ne hurt kiya.

2

Galti ko chhota na banana

“Mera intention aisa nahi tha” kehkar tumhare experience ko dismiss nahi karna.

3

Repeat na ho, uska plan banana

Sochna ki agli baar aisi situation aaye toh main alag kya karunga.

4

Tumhe waqt aur space dena

Tumhe jaldi maaf karne, reply karne ya khush hone ka pressure nahi dena.

Ek sach: Main apni taraf ki zimmedari le sakta hoon. Humara future hum dono ki marzi, comfort aur koshish se hi banega—sirf ek ke vaade se nahi.
Meri baby, ek baat yaad rakhna ♡

Har baat ko sabse bure anjaam se shuru mat karna

Kabhi-kabhi jab hum pehle se pareshan hote hain, toh dimaag kisi baat ka sabse bura matlab nikaal leta hai. Ek chhoti si khamoshi ko doori samajh lete hain, ek mushkil din ko poore future ka faisla maan lete hain. Lekin baby, har thought sach nahi hota aur har problem ka anjaam bura hi ho, zaroori nahi.

🩵 “Meri baby, kuch nahi ho raha—hum araam se dekhenge.”

Meri baby, main chahta hoon ki jab koi problem aaye, toh hum usse dekhkar turant yeh na maan lein ki sab khatam ho jayega. Pehle saans lein, phir dekhein ki asal mein hua kya hai. Jo baat abhi clear nahi hai, uska sabse bura matlab apne aap mat bana lena. Hum baat kar sakte hain, sawaal pooch sakte hain aur ek-ek karke samajh sakte hain.

Main yahin hoon, baby. Agar tum bhi chahti ho, toh jo bhi saamne aayega, hum use saath baithkar samajhne ki koshish karenge. Har cheez ka answer aaj hi milna zaroori nahi. Humein poori zindagi ek hi raat mein solve nahi karni—bas agla sahi kadam dekhna hai.

Humari kahaani mein sirf woh baatein nahi hain jinhone humein hurt kiya. Ismein woh din bhi hain jab hum khush the, jab humne ek doosre ke liye kuch special kiya, jab hum mile, hase, letters likhe aur future ke sapne dekhe. Problem ko dekhna zaroori hai, par sirf problem ko dekhkar poori kahaani ka faisla karna zaroori nahi.

Chalo, kisi bhi baat ko sirf darr se nahi, thodi umeed aur sachchai ke saath bhi dekhein. Pehle yeh poochhein: “Kya sach mein sab kharab ho raha hai, ya hum abhi ek mushkil phase se guzar rahe hain?” Phir yeh bhi poochhein: “Isse behtar banane ke liye hum aaj ek chhota sa kya kar sakte hain?”

Main tumse yeh nahi chahta ki tum apni feelings ko daba do ya har baat ko lightly lekar ignore kar do. Tumhara hurt important hai. Main bas chahta hoon ki hum overthinking ke darr mein achhe possibilities ko pehle se kharij na kar dein. Halki soch ka matlab problem ko chhota samajhna nahi; matlab hai problem ko itna bada na bana dena ki uske alawa kuch dikhai hi na de.

“Meri baby, pehle bure anjaam se shuru mat karna. Pehle sach ko dekhenge, phir achhi possibilities ko bhi jagah denge. Jo hoga, use araam se samajh lenge—ek kadam, ek din, saath aur respect ke saath.”— Ashish ki taraf se, dil se ♡
Ashvini, tumhare naam

Ek baat jo dil se kehni hai

Meri pyaari Ashvini,

Mujhe pata hai ki kuch waqt se humare beech sab pehle jaisa achha nahi chal raha. Main yeh nahi chahta ki tum apna hurt bhool jao ya meri baaton par turant bharosa kar lo. Agar meri galtiyon se tum hurt hui ho, toh tumhari feelings ki apni wajah hai. Main unhe samajhna chahta hoon.

Main maanta hoon ki har din perfect nahi hota. Kabhi hum ek doosre ko samajh nahi paate, kabhi baat bigad jaati hai. Lekin main chahta hoon ki agar tum bhi chahti ho, toh hum mushkil baaton ko blame karne ke bajaye samajhne ki koshish karein.

Main yeh promise nahi karunga ki humare beech kabhi ladai nahi hogi. Main yeh koshish karunga ki ladai ke baad tumhari baat sunoon, hurt ko ignore na karoon, aur apni galtiyon ko actions se badloon. Main chahta hoon ki meri baatein nahi, mera behaviour waqt ke saath tumhe farq mehsoos karaye.

Tumhe meri khushi ke liye apni feelings chhupane ki zaroorat nahi. Tum jo feel karti ho, woh important hai. Agar tumhe waqt ya space chahiye, main uski izzat karna chahta hoon. Main tumhe force karke kuch feel nahi karwana chahta—bas honestly apni taraf se behtar banna chahta hoon.

Humara rishta mere liye bahut important hai. Main chahta hoon ki aage ka safar respect, trust, patience aur real effort par bane. Aaj sab theek na bhi ho, toh bhi baat ko ek-ek karke samjha ja sakta hai—agar hum dono ready hon.

Tumhari feelings ki izzat ke saath,
Ashish ♡

♡ Sununga, sirf jawab nahi dunga.
♡ Galti maanunga, excuse nahi banaunga.
♡ Bharosa actions se kamaane ki koshish karunga.
♡ Tumhari feelings aur space ki izzat karunga.
Dil se ek vaada

Tumhare saath chalne ki zimmedari

Ashvini, main tumse yeh nahi kehna chahta ki tum meri wajah se ruk jao, ya apne hurt ko nazarandaaz kar do. Main bas itna kehna chahta hoon ki jab tak hum dono is rishte ko chahte hain, tumhare saath imaandari, respect aur care se chalna meri zimmedari hai. Main apni galtiyon ko sirf “galti ho gayi” kehkar chhodna nahi chahta. Main unhe samajhkar badalne ki koshish karna chahta hoon—baar-baar, sirf ek din ke liye nahi.

Mujhe pata hai humare beech achha bhi raha hai: humari yaadein, saath bitaye pal, chhoti-chhoti baatein, tumhare letters aur woh khushi jo humne mehsoos ki. Main nahi chahta ki hum sirf problems ko dekhein aur achhe palon ko bhool jaayein. Lekin main yeh bhi nahi chahta ki achhe palon ka naam lekar tumhari takleef ko chhota kar doon. Humari achhai bhi sach hai, aur humari problems bhi sach hain. Dono ko dekhkar hi hum samajh sakte hain ki kya theek karna hai.

Main dil se chahta hoon ki ek din jab tumhari mummy mujhe pyaar se “beta” kahein, ya mazaak mein “damad ji” bulaayein, toh hum dono us pal ko khushi se yaad karein. Main us din ka sapna dekhta hoon—lekin main jaanta hoon ki aisa future sirf meri khwahish se nahi, hum dono ki marzi, bharose aur waqt ke saath ki gayi koshish se banega.

Main tumse hamesha saath rehne ka faisla aaj hi karne ko nahi keh raha. Main bas chahta hoon ki agar tumhare dil mein bhi abhi is rishte ko ek mauka dene ki jagah hai, toh hum jaldi ya pressure mein nahi, dheere-dheere aur sachchai se koshish karein. Main tumhe apne actions se dikhana chahta hoon ki tumhari feelings mere liye important hain.

Tumhara Ashish ♡

🩷 Meri baby, iss duniya mein tumhara ek dost bhi hai…

Meri baby Ashvini, main chahta hoon ki tumhe meri baat ka matlab sirf bade-bade promises se nahi, balki mere behaviour se bhi samajh aaye. Iss duniya mein tumhare paas ek aisa dost bhi hai jo tumhari achhi baaton par tumhare saath khush hota hai, tumhari galti ya pareshani ko samajhne ki koshish karta hai, aur kabhi-kabhi tumhe tok bhi deta hai—shayad thoda sa “MC” ban kar 😅—par maqsad tumhe neecha dikhana nahi, balki tumhara bhala chahna hai.

Main woh insaan banna chahta hoon jo tumhari baat sune, tumhari khushi ka khayal rakhe, tumhare sapnon—NEET, doctor banne aur tumhare aage ke goals—ki izzat kare, aur jab tum pareshaan ho toh tumhare saath milkar raasta dhoondhe. Main tumhe control karne ya tumhari duniya chhoti karne nahi, balki tumhare saath ek aisa rishta banane ki koshish karna chahta hoon jahan tum apni marzi, apni pehchaan aur apne sapnon ke saath safe mehsoos karo.

Haan baby, main tumhe bahut pyaar karta hoon. Tumhe apna maan kar mandir mein tumhari khushi aur humare rishte ke liye dua bhi karta hoon. Main tumhare paas rehna chahta hoon, tumhara saath nibhana chahta hoon aur apni galtiyon ko sudhaarne ke liye mehnat karna chahta hoon. Lekin main yeh bhi jaanta hoon ki pyaar sirf kehne se nahi hota—bharosa, respect, patience aur badla hua behaviour bhi zaroori hai. Main tumse apni feelings ki wajah se koi faisla karne ka pressure nahi daalna chahta.

Baby, kabhi humare beech kuch achha ho, toh use bhi yaad rakhna; aur jab problem aaye, toh use bhi imaandari se dekhna. Humari achhi memories problems ko jhootha nahi banati, aur problems humari saari achhi memories ko mita nahi deti. Dono sach hain. Agar hum dono chahein, toh hum dheere-dheere samajh sakte hain ki kya sudharna hai aur kaise ek-doosre ke liye behtar partner banna hai.

“Meri baby, main tumhara dost bhi banna chahta hoon, tumhara support bhi—aur woh insaan bhi jo tumhari khushi, izzat aur sapnon ka khayal rakhe. Main yahin hoon; hum aaj ki baat aaj samjhenge, bina har baar sabse bure anjaam tak pahunchne ke.”— Tumhara Ashish, dil se ♡

Aur ek chhota sa sapna… Kabhi agar tumhari mummy mujhe pyaar se “beta” kahein, ya “damad ji” kehkar bulaayein, toh woh mere liye bahut khaas pal hoga. Main us future ki umeed rakhta hoon, baby—aur jaanta hoon ki woh tabhi khoobsurat hoga jab hum dono apni marzi se, bharose aur khushi ke saath us taraf badhenge.

Tera Ashish — tera dost, tera support, aur tumse bahut pyaar karne wala insaan. ♡
